ar.title: شوربة حمص كثيفة على العيش

steps.n2: اطهه مع البصل في ضعف حجمه من الماء النظيف 20–30 دقيقة. احتفظ بكوب من المرقة.
steps.n3: أضف الثوم والكمون وعصير الليمون إلى الحمص، واضربه في الخلاط أو اهرسه حتى يصبح عجينة خفيفة.
steps.n4: أعده إلى النار، وأضف الزيت، وتبّل، واتركه 3–5 دقائق.
steps.n5: قطّع العيش قطعاً 2–3 سم وافرشها في طبق التقديم.
steps.n6: سخّن المرقة المحفوظة، وبلّل بها العيش، وصبّ شوربة الحمص فوقه.

en.title: Thick Chickpea Soup over Bread (Shurbit Hummus)
en.intro: Recipe 381, page 164 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.
steps.n2: Cook them with the onions in twice their volume of fresh water for 20–30 minutes. Keep back one cup of the broth.
steps.n3: Add the garlic, cumin and lemon juice to the chickpeas and blend or mash into a thin paste.
steps.n4: Return to the heat, add the oil, season, and cook for 3–5 minutes.
steps.n5: Cut the bread into 2–3 cm pieces and line the serving dish with them.
steps.n6: Reheat the reserved broth, moisten the bread with it and pour the chickpea soup over.

legacySteps: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.
Cook them with the onions in twice their volume of fresh water for 20–30 minutes. Keep back one cup of the broth.
Add the garlic, cumin and lemon juice to the chickpeas and blend or mash into a thin paste.
Return to the heat, add the oil, season, and cook for 3–5 minutes.
Cut the bread into 2–3 cm pieces and line the serving dish with them.
Reheat the reserved broth, moisten the bread with it and pour the chickpea soup over.
